set up
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(skimr)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(broom)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

set.seed(42)


```


importdata & checking
```{r}

df_raw <- readr::read_csv("merged_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
glimpse(df_raw)
skim(df_raw)
na_summary <- df_raw %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "col", values_to = "na_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(na_count))
na_summary

```



BTC
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(skimr)


df <- df_raw %>%
  filter(Symbol == "BTC") %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(Date),
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    wday = wday(date, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),
    is_weekend = wday %in% c("Sat", "Sun")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)

glimpse(df)
skim(df %>% select(date, year, month, wday, is_weekend))


```

seems good



```{r}

names(df)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(vol = `σ_Rt`)
summary(df$vol)

ggplot(df, aes(x = vol)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  labs(
    title = "3.1 Distribution of Bitcoin Volatility",
    x = "Volatility",
    y = "Count"
  )
ggplot(df, aes(x = date, y = vol)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "3.2 Bitcoin Volatility Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Volatility"
  )


```


corr analysis
```{r}

df_analysis <- df %>%
  select(
    date,
    vol,
    log_volume = Log_Volume,
    volume = Volume,
    news = European_News_Index,
    sepu = SEPU,
    btc_dom = BitcoinDominance,
    ret = Return
  )
library(ggcorrplot)

corr_mat <- cor(
  df_analysis %>% select(-date),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

ggcorrplot(corr_mat, type = "lower", lab = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("3.3Correlation Matrix: Volatility and Potential Factors")
ggplot(df_analysis, aes(x = log_volume, y = vol)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "3.4Trading Volume vs Bitcoin Volatility",
    x = "Log Trading Volume",
    y = "Volatility"
  )


```


```{r}

corr_rank <- df_analysis %>%
  select(-date) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~cor(.x, df_analysis$vol, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "corr_with_vol") %>%
  filter(variable != "vol") %>%
  mutate(abs_corr = abs(corr_with_vol)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_corr))

corr_rank
knitr::kable(
  corr_rank,
  caption = "Table 3.1: Correlation Ranking of Potential Influencing Factors"
)

ggplot(df_analysis, aes(x = log_volume, y = vol)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Log Trading Volume vs Bitcoin Volatility",
    x = "Log Trading Volume",
    y = "Volatility"
  )
ggplot(df_analysis, aes(x = news, y = vol)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "European News Index vs Bitcoin Volatility",
    x = "European News Index",
    y = "Volatility"
  )

```



```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(stargazer)
df_model <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    log_volume_l1 = lag(log_volume, 1),
    news_l1 = lag(news, 1),
    sepu_l1 = lag(sepu, 1),
    btc_dom_l1 = lag(btc_dom, 1),
    ret_l1 = lag(ret, 1)
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

m1 <- lm(vol ~ log_volume_l1 + news_l1 + sepu_l1 + btc_dom_l1 + ret_l1, data = df_model)


summary(m1)

coeftest(m1, vcov. = NeweyWest(m1, lag = 5, prewhite = FALSE, adjust = TRUE))
stargazer(m1, type="text")


```
